title: Writing a new select option to Airtable fails with INVALID_MULTIPLE_CHOICE_OPTIONS
symptoms: Write works for existing options and fails for any new value
Value with different capitalization or trailing space is rejected
cause: Select fields accept only values that exactly match an existing option. Creating a new option on write requires typecast, which is off by default.
fix: Pass typecast true when the integration may send new option values, or normalize values to the existing option list first.
apply: await base("Leads").create([{ fields: { Source: "Podcast" } }], { typecast: true });
affected: Airtable Web API, singleSelect and multipleSelects fields, as of 2026-10
